title: Primer of the Steady Breath
summary: A primer on slow breathing that teaches a new Warrior to lead plain qi through the body and spend it in small steady amounts.

title: The First Circuit Handbook
summary: A handbook of the first closed loop of qi through arms and legs with simple strikes and guards built on that loop.

title: A Guide to Gathered Qi
summary: A guide to pooling qi at the dantian before use and releasing it in a palm strike or a guard.

title: Foundations of the Pulse Strike
summary: A foundation course in landing blows on the beat of the pulse so that qi arrives with the fist or palm.

title: The Even Flow Reader
summary: A reader for keeping qi level in the channels so that every strike guard step and mending draws on the same calm current.

title: Lessons in Qi Guarding
summary: Lessons in covering the body with a thin skin of qi to turn aside blows and ease the hurt of those that land.

title: The Thread Sense Primer
summary: A primer on spinning qi into fine threads that feel the body of another or bind a limb for a moment.

title: Handbook of the Light Step
summary: A handbook of short qi-aided strides that carry a Warrior off a line of attack and back into reach.

title: The Mending Breath Course
summary: A course in using plain qi to ease bruises and fatigue in oneself and in companions after a bout.

title: Principles of Pressure and Release
summary: Principles of compressing qi in the palm and letting it go all at once to shove strike or pin.
